Features

  • Darkvision

    Can see in the dark up to a certain distance.

  • Greater Wyrm's Scales

    All incoming damage is reduced by 4.

  • Legendary Action: Draconic Fury

    The dragon can retaliate against an attacker with its breath weapon once per round.

  • Magic Resistance

    Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

  • Opportunity Attack

    Attack an enemy moving out of reach.

A Dominated Red Dragon can be encountered Atop the Netherbrain in Act Three.

Overview

Always hostile and psychically enslaved by the  Netherbrain, it serves as a major enemy in the final combat encounter of the game.

Combat

The Dominated  Red Dragon is a Githyanki Dragon cohort which has been mind-controlled by the Netherbrain into defending the  Crown of Karsus. Befitting a dragon encountered at the very end of the game, its base level and statistics are formidable even for a full-level party.

Notes
